description.value:
You ignite a chakra-enhanced smoke pellet at a point within range. The detonation creates a 10-foot-radius cloud of dense smoke for 1 minute.

Creatures in the smoke are concealed; creatures outside the smoke who try to perceive anything inside have the same. A strong wind (Reppushou or similar) can dispel the cloud one round early.

This jutsu is a quick stand-in for the consumable smoke pellets every shinobi carries; players using actual smoke-pellet equipment in M5+ may prefer those.

Heightened (3rd) Burst increases to 15 feet; the cloud lasts up to 10 minutes if undisturbed.
